title: V3B2 : Bug data from different pomps
symptom: After deactivating an old EROS pod and activating a new one, an error message 'data from different pumps' appeared. Also, during pod change, the screen froze and Android showed 'Wait or Close' message.
cause: The issue was a duplicate of #782 and #775. The 'data from different pumps' error was fixed by a commit, and the screen freeze was fixed by another commit.
fix: The fixes were provided in commits: 'data from different pumps' fixed by commit 85178ee19ff628dfe4422409973c6f8ae7b511b5, and 'screen freeze' fixed by commit 52e343213249c0abff26aab4756b5c9edf8755c3.
evidence_quote: The 'data from different pumps' should be fixed with https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/85178ee19ff628dfe4422409973c6f8ae7b511b5 'screen freeze' should be fixed with https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/52e343213249c0abff26aab4756b5c9edf8755c3
